wiktionary.japanese_section:
{{ja-kanjitab|あさ|はん|yomi=kun,kanon|alt=朝御飯,朝ごはん}}

===Etymology===
From {{ja-compound|朝|あさ|t1=morning|御%飯|ご%はん|t2=meal}}.

===Pronunciation===
{{ja-pron|あさ ごはん|acc=3|acc_ref=DJR,NHK}}

===Noun===
{{ja-noun|あさごはん}}

# [[breakfast]]

====Usage notes====
The ''go-'' prefix in {{m|ja|御飯|tr=gohan}} is more often written in [[hiragana]], as {{m|ja|ご}}.

====Synonyms====
* {{ja-r|朝食|ちょうしょく}}

====Related terms====
* {{ja-r|ご飯|ごはん}}: meal
* {{ja-r|昼ご飯|ひるごはん}}: lunch
* {{ja-r|夕ご飯|ゆうごはん}}, {{ja-r|晚ご飯|ばんごはん}}: dinner

===References===
{{reflist}}
